title: Coordinate correction probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on strings of length $2^n$, let $j$ be a coordinate in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $b$ be a Boolean bit. The coordinate correction probability is the uniform probability over Boolean strings $y$ of length $2^n$ that the local correction of the sign version of $f$, at the truth table encoding the $j$th coordinate, evaluated at $y$, equals the sign corresponding to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on strings of length $2^n$
